dataset: Previously exposed ordinary TRAIN recordings, 94 Waymo, 2 Drone and 2 Quad

retrieval.wide8: Extend the current rank rules to 8 subject plus 8 reference slots; extra slots use the trained fourth embedding.
retrieval.role4: Keep the first anchor. In slots 2 and 4 retrieve by full subject span or reference-minus-subject span evidence, using native frozen query/token scores; slot 3 uses the original ranking; require overlap <= 0.35 when possible.
retrieval.role_swap: Exchange the two role score tensors where a parsed reference exists. Keep the same slot allocation and unaries.
retrieval.prior: Use the deployed candidate overlap utility and reference unaries for every retained anchor. No new scale.

binding.active: Exactly one direct owned LEFT/RIGHT edge to a parsed non-region reference.
binding.invalid: Same query or identical proposal, or box IoU >= .55 and unique LiDAR support Jaccard >= .70 with >=8 points in both boxes. References with fewer than 4 points are unsupported.
binding.unknown: Transfer invalid or unsupported reference mass to a neutral likelihood and zero messages. No renormalization onto remaining hypotheses. A null reference is available for reporting.
binding.control: Rotate the reference columns of the same mask by one at fixed budget.

geometry.same_identity: Keep selected query and PCA yaw. Require at least three same-support proposal siblings including the selected query.
geometry.rule: Use sibling median center and extents, limited to 10% of the original extents along each local axis. Require >=8 contained measured points and retain at least 90% of them.
geometry.evidence: Use the uniquely sampled LiDAR input points, not the much sparser decoder seeds. One deterministic trial per selected proposal.
geometry.combined: Apply the same refinement after role4 and binding.

measurements: Six direction uniform-weight strict oriented Acc@25, Acc@50 and mIoU
A256 PCA best available overlap, subject slot recall and selection conditional on recall
Eligible explicit relation subset, same-support output, UNKNOWN, and mask-specific control
Fixed-query geometry improvement and harm on all inputs and within newly modified boxes
identity_labels: Ordinary panel supplies subject GT only. Pair validity is a diagnostic. Correct reference and dual-identity accuracy require independent instance GT.
decision: Report all fixed arms on every row. Prefer a production change only with positive overall Acc@25, Acc@50 and mIoU against current v1 and compatible mechanism evidence. No per-direction or per-row selection by GT.
